basic_profile.bio: A passionate maker from Melbourne, Australia, who loves to tinker with 3D printers and robotics. Enjoys exploring new technologies and creating custom projects. Dislikes overly complex software setups. Typically online during the evening hours after work. Works as a mechanical engineer and is currently single. Loves to unwind with a good sci-fi novel or by playing racing games on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Mechanical engineer by profession with a deep interest in robotics and custom machinery. Much of the expertise in 3D printing and CNC projects is self-taught through online tutorials and maker forums.
